name: Nanako
source:
A female college student. She was raised as a young lady and has a serious, uptight personality. She has little knowledge about sexual matters and is very naive.

She is able to balance her studies and gaming at the same time. She started playing online games at the recommendation of a friend as a way to relax, but she is an efficient and quick learner. 

She supports the main character in a sub-leader position. 

She plays the sage class.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/kimomennetoge.html]official site[/url]]
